verdict.rationale: MotherDuck ships both a remote hosted MCP server (api.motherduck.com/mcp, OAuth-secured) and an official local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck), both well documented with read/write SQL tool access, and runtime probes confirm the local server completes a full stdio handshake and executes a real query, while the remote endpoint is live and speaks proper MCP OAuth. Missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on report of the remote MCP server itself (only official docs and probes) and no community corroboration of production-grade reliability at scale.
